title: Fixed Slotted Front Fence and Low Disc Joiner
description: One newly authored complete static front-fence biscuit-joiner-style exterior. One low broad gear head has a true finite front slot, a fixed retracted blunt horizontal disk and central spindle. Its long rear axial motor grip ends in a cap, cable cue and grounded heel. A separate full tall front face has a matching true slot and a continuous forward-projecting horizontal upper ledge. Two whole side carriages, vertical guides and proud locking knobs attach that fence to the head, while a complete upper auxiliary arch has a true empty grip opening. This whole tall referencing face and ledge ahead of the low enclosed head and rear grip differs from the exposed upright circular saw on a long ground shoe and the vertical dual-post router. All geometry newly authored; no old components imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, grounded horizontal-envelope-centred origin. One prop zero scenes. Fixed illustrative exterior only: no cutting teeth, workpiece, motor, disk rotation, plunge or fence adjustment, joinery accuracy, electrical capability, manufacture, handling suitability or safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
